scope: Static independent review of source/Agent acceptance and Python/Khronos/Three/browser verification; no product requests or tests in this review

findings.title: Unintended carrier scaling can evade destination checks
findings.evidence: Inherited Decoded.pose ignores node.scale and scale animation channels. Both acceptance artifact checks and Three/browser compare translation and rotation only. Native geometry multiplication by inverse carrier.matrixWorld removes carrier scaling before corner checks. A uniform carrier scale of2 leaves local corners, materials, counts and motion assertions unchanged while doubling visible geometry.
findings.action: Require identity node/world scale and forbid scale channels at .9 independent boundaries; add independent synthetic tamper control.

findings.title: Pinned-library assertion compares local bundles rather than accepted stored source
findings.evidence: run_holes_acceptance constructs repaired_source with original_source.modules, then compares those same raw module bytes. The assertion alone does not inspect actual accepted durable source. The separate focused Agent cohort already does inspect service.read_program.
findings.action: Read the accepted repaired bundle through service.read_program and compare its entry/revision/module bytes with frozen expected source and original library.

nonblocking_assessments: All55frozen source rows are iterated and hashed against acceptance-freeze before execution;17valid,34invalid,4source-valid-delivery-rejected cases.
Analytic geometry checks import no production runtime or triangulator and use independent convex clipping plus complete authored boundary and opposite directed-edge incidence.

All cap corners bind uniquely to independently authored identities within1e-5m; inner walls retain outgoing material and outward-normal checks; decoded area, volume, perimeter and PBRvalues are measured.
Agent workflow executes all12operations with separate schema and durability checks, scoped repair, sibling mesh preservation, stale cursor refusal and current lower policy failure.

Destination checker requires passed acceptance, exact artifact SHA256, matching program revision, pinned verifier dependencies, zero Khronos errors/warnings and Three/browser recorded motion; seven representative artifacts request14captures whose visual inspection remains separate.
